windows_remove_command: $ErrorActionPreference='Stop'; $d=Join-Path $HOME .ssh; $f=Join-Path $d authorized_keys; $e=New-Object Text.UTF8Encoding $false; if (Test-Path $f) { $k=@([IO.File]::ReadAllLines($f,$e) | Where-Object { $_ -notmatch ' habitat:alice@habitat\.example\.org$' }); [IO.File]::WriteAllLines("$f.habitat",[string[]]$k,$e); Move-Item -Force "$f.habitat" $f }
windows_admin_remove_command: $ErrorActionPreference='Stop'; $d=Join-Path $env:ProgramData ssh; $f=Join-Path $d administrators_authorized_keys; $e=New-Object Text.UTF8Encoding $false; if (Test-Path $f) { $k=@([IO.File]::ReadAllLines($f,$e) | Where-Object { $_ -notmatch ' habitat:alice@habitat\.example\.org$' }); [IO.File]::WriteAllLines("$f.habitat",[string[]]$k,$e); Move-Item -Force "$f.habitat" $f; icacls.exe $f /inheritance:r /grant '*S-1-5-32-544:F' /grant '*S-1-5-18:F' | Out-Null; if ($LASTEXITCODE) { throw 'icacls' } }
